title: [GAME] Made a simple iOS game that my family think is fun
author: Mission-Ad8895
selftext: I tried to make a simple fun game for iOS  [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/void-drifter-space-survivor/id6789818576](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/void-drifter-space-survivor/id6789818576)  using only codex and claude code to share with friends and family. They seemed to like it so why not try to publish it on App Store ? I did, shared it on [pixelpicked.com](http://pixelpicked.com) and got 8 on their launch ranking last week. Well nobody told me that making a game is the easy part, although it has gone through a lot of balancing and iterations to get right, and getting people to actually play it the hard part lol. I'd love to hear some feedback if anyone tries it out.
